concept: A printed data poster in motion: a huge counter, then a ruled bar chart that dims everything except the peak, then a hard black closing slab with the instruction.

narrativeArc.beginning: A single shocking number: 412 cups at 8 am.
narrativeArc.middle: The whole day's bars show the 8 am peak against the 2 pm lull.
narrativeArc.end: The decision: staff for 8 am, not 2 pm.
narrativeArc.viewerTakeaway: Peak demand is 3.5x the afternoon lull, so schedule staff to the peak.

typography.hierarchy: hero number 560 / closing lines 190 / headings 120 / labels 44-72; one hero per scene
typography.pairingReason: Condensed Oswald lets a three-digit number fill a 1080px-wide column; Inter keeps labels neutral and legible at phone size.

designSystem.accentRule: Red marks exactly the peak: one rule under the number, the peak bar, and the word 8 AM. Never decoration.

background.notes: flat light-grey ground in scenes 1-2, solid ink slab in scene 3; no texture

composition.grid: single column, left-aligned at x=108, 6 bar rows on a 120px rhythm
composition.safeAreas: action 90%, title 80%, plus platform keep-out top 250 / bottom 420 / right 120

transitionLanguage.primary: six horizontal slats retract from the top to reveal the incoming scene (15 frames)
transitionLanguage.rule: Slats are ink on light scenes and light on the ink slab, so the seam is always high contrast; they travel down the vertical reading axis.

pacing.rhythm: 3.4s / 4.0s / 3.0s — number lands fast, chart gets the longest hold

designSystem.densityReason: Deliberate Swiss data-poster contrast example: numerals and a bar chart carry each beat.

consistencyRules: All text sits left-aligned at x=108 and inside y 250..1500.
Red appears only on the peak (rule, bar, 8 AM).
Numbers use Oswald, words use Inter.
Every scene entry uses the slat transition.
Bars share one baseline and one scale (max 412 = 640px).
antiPatterns: No dark gradient background or glow behind numbers
No pie or donut chart for six hourly values
No data without a label naming the unit
No text in the top 250px or bottom 420px
No bar animation that overshoots the real value
